fields.System.Title: RET-401 — Restock as new
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want inspected-as-new returns put back into sellable stock,
so that good goods are sold again rather than written off.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an inspection grade of "as new", when I restock, then the stock moves from
  • quarantine to a normal storage location with available status.
  • - Given the restock, then a new receipt date is recorded — the stock is not treated
  • as being as old or as fresh as the original batch.
  • - Given an expiry-tracked product, then the expiry re-captured at inspection is used, not
  • the original batch's.
  • - Given the restock, then a putaway task is created rather than assuming a location.
  • - Given the restock, then returns.stock_restocked is published.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory, inbound |
| Tables | disposition, stock_balance, stock_movement, batch |
| Risks | Restocked with the original expiry ([doc 09 §8.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
